name: FormFarm
tagline: Professional form backend service for collecting and managing form submissions without maintaining a dedicated backend for each project.
description: FormFarm is a developer-friendly form backend service and private alternative to platforms like Formspree. Developers can point an HTML form or AJAX request to a unique FormFarm endpoint to store submissions in MongoDB, parse payloads, send email notifications, filter spam, and view submission activity in a dashboard.
problemStatement: Developers often need to create and maintain backend infrastructure just to receive HTML form submissions across their projects.
solution: FormFarm provides unique public form endpoints, submission storage, a management dashboard, and email notifications so developers can collect form data without building a separate form-processing backend for every project.

features.name: User authentication and session security
details: Registration, login, and logout
Password hashing with bcryptjs and cryptographically secure salts
Signed JWT session cookies using HttpOnly and SameSite=lax

features.name: Dashboard and activity stream
details: Real-time counter of active form endpoints
Chronological stream of recent form submissions
Server-side data fetching designed for high concurrency

features.name: Cryptographic endpoint keys
details: Generates 16-character hexadecimal keys using Node.js crypto.randomBytes(8)

features.name: Public form submission endpoint
details: Accepts standard HTML form POST requests using application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/form-data
Supports JSON payloads from fetch and AJAX
Supports CORS headers with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Automatically parses submitted field names without requiring predefined schemas
Redirects browser form submissions to a confirmation page with HTTP 303
Non-POST visits redirect to an endpoint guide

features.name: Client telemetry and geolocation
details: Resolves client IP using proxy and cloud headers
Tracks submitter country and city
Captures User-Agent information
Stores telemetry in MongoDB and displays it in the dashboard

features.name: Submission viewer and management
details: Chronological submission indexing
Syntax-highlighted key-value payload inspection
Single-submission deletion and bulk deletion with confirmation safeguards

features.name: Email notifications
details: Sends instant notifications to form owners
Includes responsive HTML email and plain-text fallback
Includes submitted payload and client IP, city, country, and User-Agent

features.name: Dark cyberpunk UI
details: Custom Vanilla CSS design system
Orbitron and Inter Google Fonts, with Outfit used in test UI
HTML5 Canvas particle background with interactive connecting lines and mouse effects
Glassmorphism cards and neon-red hover effects

features.name: Developer testing suite
details: Standalone test form supporting standard POST and AJAX modes
3D parallax test interface
13-stage automated end-to-end test runner

Creates a form endpoint with a unique key.
Deletes a form and its associated submissions.

Accepts public form submissions; CORS is supported.
Redirects visitors to the endpoint guide.
